sn45.2:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sakyesu viharati Sakkaraṃ nāma Sakyānaṃ nigamo || || 2.
sn45.2:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn45.2:1.4: Upaḍḍham idam bhante brahmacariyassa yad idaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyānasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā ti || || 3.
sn45.2:2.1: Mā hevam Ānanda mā hevam Ānanda || ||
sn45.2:2.2: Sakalam eva hidam Ānanda brahmacariyaṃ yad idaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā || ||
sn45.2:2.3: Kalyāṇamittassetam Ānanda bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkham kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkarissati || || 4.
sn45.2:3.1: Kathañcānanda bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko ariyam atthaṅgikam maggam bahulīkaroti || ||
sn45.2:3.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ ||
sn45.2:3.9: sammāsamādhim bhāveti vivekanissitam virāganissitam nirodhanissitam vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn45.2:3.10: Evaṃ kho Ānanda bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto kalyaṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggam bhāveti ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkaroti || || 5.
sn45.2:4.1: Tad aminā petam Ānanda pariyāyena veditabbaṃ || yathā sakalam evidam brahmacariyaṃ yad idam kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyānasampavaṅkatā || ||
sn45.2:4.2: Mamaṃ hi Ānanda kalyāṇamittam āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti || jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti || maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti || sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti || ||
sn45.2:4.3: Iminā kho etam Ānanda pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā sakalam evidam brahmacariyaṃ yad idaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā
